notes: External native destructor overriding SimplePeer.clear(); maps to libvorbis vorbis_block_clear(vb). Name already matches convention used across SimplePeer subclasses (VorbisComment, VorbisInfo, DSPState all have identically-shaped clear()); left as-is for consistency.

Private external native constructor helper invoked from the primary constructor's init block (this.init(arg0)); mirrors libvorbis vorbis_block_init(vd, vb). Renamed to avoid confusion with Kotlin's init{} block keyword while keeping the DSPState link explicit. Param arg0 is the DSPState this block synthesizes into (constructor param, confirmed via DSPState.kt which takes VorbisInfo and VorbisBlock.blockIn(VorbisBlock) call site in DSPState.kt).

External native call matching libvorbis vorbis_synthesis(vb, op); decodes one Ogg packet into this block. Confirmed call site in VorbisOggDecoder.kt: `aVorbisBlock9000!!.synthesis(oggpacket) == 0` then feeds result into DSPState.blockIn(vorbisBlock) (vorbis_synthesis_blockin), matching the standard libvorbis decode pipeline order (synthesis -> blockin -> pcmout).
